author: Dandrista
title: Looking for 2D anime artist specializing in Jinx and Pokémon
content: LONG THREAD ALERT! I am looking for a 2D artist (or artists) specializing in the anime style, with experience drawing Jinx and Pokémon! If you are interested, please drop your VGen link! (DMs will be blocked, unless you have worked with me previously.) #vgen #VgenComm I want to share more precise details about what I’m looking for, as there were some misunderstandings regarding my request! I’ll break it down to help you better understand what I need: 1st: 2 PFPs (Profile Pictures) – Both featuring Jinx in outfits from Pokémon Masters EX; one with Zekrom, and the other with Jolteon. 2nd: Twitch/YouTube Banner – A single, unified banner for both channels, featuring three characters: Luna Snow, Jinx, and Goku. Twitch Panels and multiple illustrations including Pokémon themes. In total, there will be 8 separate illustrations. Budget is $120–$150 for the whole project, open to negotiation. Contact: drop VGen link or DM with specific phrase. Email: melerod72@gmail.com
